from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperInfo(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the collection: its title and the titles of other collection papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (in the collection) that this paper cites")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperInfo]
